labelMeaning: AI-authored source relevance, never guilt, truth of an allegation, personal propensity or probability. A negative is query-specific relevance, not a factual denial.
inputKind: 435 retained nonlegacy source summaries with locators and limitations. Full documents and case answers are not embedded.

splitPolicy.unit: exact original-source family, reviewed case, repeated substantive party and reserved independent-test neighborhoods
splitPolicy.developmentSeed: All education/water sources and connected evidence families; selected before training to test domain/source-family generalization.
splitPolicy.scope: Split isolation uses available exact identities, source URLs and reviewed cases. Unknown external duplicates or hidden ownership are not claimed resolved.

limitations: Authored source summaries, not full PDFs or public-bank ledgers.
Legacy citation-only rows excluded from this supervised corpus but retained in the evidence graph.
Test source documents may be indexed for final retrieval evaluation, but never used for gradients, negatives, checkpoint selection or dev scoring.
Development is a deliberately held-out service domain; it is not representative of all Indian institutions.
This is a source/entity holdout, not a historical forecast backtest. Publication dates do not establish pre-outcome availability.
A long source packet can exceed encoder limits; encoder reports must disclose truncation.

Right of Children to Free and Compulsory Education Act, 2009
Publisher: Government of India / Ministry of Education
Section 12(1)(c) provides entry-level admissions for eligible disadvantaged/weaker-section children of at least 25% in specified categories of schools. Section 12(2) provides private unaided school reimbursement capped at state per-child expenditure or actual charge, whichever is lower, with provisos for pre-existing free-education obligations.
Locator: Sections 12(1)(c) and 12(2), consolidated copy updated 26 July 2021
Limitations: Not an unrestricted private-school capital grant. School eligibility, constitutional/applicability exclusions, neighbourhood rules and claims are determined by applicable law and state implementation. Statutory eligibility is not evidence of payment.

documents.text:

Publisher: Comptroller and Auditor General of India

CAG assessed ₹62.76 crore avoidable storage/supervision expenditure. FCI management said hiring anticipated a bumper paddy crop and finalized guaranteed-hiring tenders could not be cancelled without litigation; CAG rejected the explanation.

Underlying ministry had not replied on this point according to the report; subsequent recovery/action was not established. Direct-origin request returned HTTP 503; official-domain indexed extract was reviewed through the relevant section.

Publisher: Press Information Bureau, Government of India

Rationalisation of Fertilizer Subsidy — Lok Sabha Q3255
Publisher: Ministry of Chemicals & Fertilizers / Lok Sabha
Answer says fertilizer subsidy is released to companies based on actual authenticated retail sales. Limitations: Do not invent state fertilizer subsidy amounts from national company payments or from quantities supplied. Subsidized sale, warehouse stock, agronomic need and farmer access are different measures. Published matrix extraction is malformed; financial values not normalized.
